HADESANCIENTS-CARDIO_GAIN.title: Cardio Gain
HADESANCIENTS-CARDIO_GAIN.description: Every [blue]{HitsNeeded}[/blue] times you hit an enemy with an Attack, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
HADESANCIENTS-CARDIO_GAIN.flavor: "We'll turn that flicker in your step into a roaring flame!"
HADESANCIENTS-CONTROLLED_BURN.title: Controlled Burn
HADESANCIENTS-CONTROLLED_BURN.descriptio: You may [gold]Burn[/gold] card rewards to Hestia. For each card burned, upgrade a random card in your [gold]Deck[/gold].
HADESANCIENTS-CONTROLLED_BURN.flavor: "Sacrifices sometimes must be made, dearie. So round them up and put them to the flame!"
HADESANCIENTS-FIRE_AWAY.title: Fire Away
HADESANCIENTS-FIRE_AWAY.description: Whenever you hit an enemy with an Attack, gain [blue]{Block:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
HADESANCIENTS-FIRE_AWAY.flavor: "Don't let the fire in your heart sputter out, all right?"
HADESANCIENTS-FLAME_FLOURISH.title: Flame Flourish
HADESANCIENTS-FLAME_FLOURISH.description: Whenever you play a Skill, gain [blue]{VigorPower}[/blue] [gold]Vigor[/gold].
HADESANCIENTS-FLAME_FLOURISH.flavor: "Well now I reckon it's time to fan the flames a bit, isn't it then?"
HADESANCIENTS-FLAME_STRIKE.title: Flame Strike
HADESANCIENTS-FLAME_STRIKE.description: The first [blue]{Cards}[/blue] Attacks you play from your [gold]Hand[/gold] each combat are played an additional time.
HADESANCIENTS-FLAME_STRIKE.flavor: "Eh, a right good burn like that deserves another. Only fair, don't you agree, hot stuff?"
HADESANCIENTS-FLASH_FRY.title: Flash Fry
HADESANCIENTS-FLASH_FRY.description: At the start of combat, gain [blue]{FavorStartCombat}[/blue] [gold]Favor[/gold]. At the end of your turn, lose [blue]{FavorLossEachTurn}[/blue] [gold]Favor[/gold]. When combat ends, gain 30 [gold]Gold[/gold] per [gold]Favor[/gold]. If you defeat an Elite with any [gold]Favor[/gold] remaining, obtain an additional Relic reward.
HADESANCIENTS-FLASH_FRY.flavor: "Some evening, mayhaps you'll settle down to a nice comfortable life, but ohh, not tonight!"
HADESANCIENTS-GLOWING_COAL.title: Glowing Coal
HADESANCIENTS-GLOWING_COAL.description: At the start of each combat, add [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [gold]{Cards:plural:Fireball|Fireballs}[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
HADESANCIENTS-GLOWING_COAL.flavor: "Let's keep that everlasting flame alive and well, what say you, hot stuff?"
HADESANCIENTS-HEAT_RUSH.title: Heat Rush
HADESANCIENTS-HEAT_RUSH.description: At the start of each turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and [gold]Exhaust[/gold] [blue]{CardsToExhaust}[/blue] {CardsToExhaust:plural:card|cards} from your [gold]Hand[/gold].
HADESANCIENTS-HEAT_RUSH.flavor: "All right, hot stuff! We're turning up the temperature to get things roaring, then!"
HADESANCIENTS-HIGHLY_FLAMMABLE.title: Highly Flammable
HADESANCIENTS-HIGHLY_FLAMMABLE.descripti: Whenever you apply a debuff to an enemy, apply [blue]{MoreStacks}[/blue] additional stacks.
HADESANCIENTS-HIGHLY_FLAMMABLE.flavor: "What say we add a little fuel to this fire we've got going, why don't we?"
HADESANCIENTS-HOT_POT.title: Hot Pot
HADESANCIENTS-HOT_POT.description: Whenever you would lose HP, lose [blue]{HpLossReduction}[/blue] less.
HADESANCIENTS-HOT_POT.flavor: "Play with fire and you get yourself burned! It’s just as simple as that unless I say otherwise."
HADESANCIENTS-SLOW_COOKER.title: Slow Cooker
HADESANCIENTS-SLOW_COOKER.description: You can now [gold]Slow Cook[/gold] at Rest Sites.
HADESANCIENTS-SLOW_COOKER.flavor: "I've been cooking up a little something special just for you, hot stuff!"
HADESANCIENTS-SMOLDER_RING.title: Smolder Ring
HADESANCIENTS-SMOLDER_RING.description: At the end of your turn, deal damage equal to [blue]{Damage:diff()}[/blue] times the number of Attacks played this turn to ALL enemies.
HADESANCIENTS-SMOLDER_RING.flavor: "Everything's going to be covered in soot by the time we're through!"
